content.text:
[build-system]
requires = [
    "hatchling>=1.18",
]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "xoev-adapter"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Minimal XOEV → JSON adapter as a FastAPI service"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi[standard]>=0.115.14",
    "starlette>=1.3.1",
    "xmlschema>=2.5",
    "prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator>=7.1.0",
    "aio-pika>=9.5.7",
    "saxonche>=12.7.0",
    "shapely>=2.0.4",
    "defusedxml>=0.7.1",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.14.2",
]

[project.scripts]
xoev-adapter = "xoev_adapter:main.main"
xoev-adapter-dev = "xoev_adapter:main.dev"
export-openapi-json = "xoev_adapter.scripts:export_openapi.export_openapi_json"

[dependency-groups]
test = [
    "pytest>=8.4.1",
    "pytest-cov>=6.0",
    "httpx>=0.27",
]
dev = [
    "pre-commit>=4.2.0",
    "mypy>=1.17.0",
    "pylint>=3.3.8",
    "pylint-pydantic>=0.3.5",
    "ruff>=0.5.0",
    "bandit>=1.7.0",
    "pika>=1.3.0",
    { include-group = "test" },
]

[tool.bandit]
skips = [
    "B101",
    "B104",
    "B405",
]

[tool.mypy]
explicit_package_bases = true
python_version = "3.12"
strict = true
pretty = true
show_error_codes = true
mypy_path = "src"
